These comments preserve the final audit without a new commit or CI cycle.

All specified inputs matched live GitHub. Live main was `cb532242c7aa86c6af5b6232b71c0906ea38f5c5`; no main merge occurred. PR150 `4fc00b1fbc57f10f6c0c6352dee702e1738f65b7` is reference only, not merged; old simulated tree `2c61c7d79bf9a95c4f04ccdbda8fae1fe15d5491` was not reused.

Six shared paths were recomputed; two text conflicts preserve both skill sections and the full installed-harness/sdist-checker import union. Four automatic merges preserve distribution authority, bounded archive checks and workflow failure propagation/always-upload. [Exact source/final blob provenance](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/fee364c6d61a5feebf08dbdd830a5a57ee2d872b/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6b-sdist-c0-integration-20261024/audit/provenance-results.json) and original conflict stages are retained. All160 product blobs, both exact Transfer SQL fences and all31 preexisting numbered Accepted ADRs equal154; ADR0033 equals144. Historical FAIL reviews/evidence are unchanged.

Actual local results (overlapping lanes are never summed):

- **One final ordinary source run: 6,497 unique = 6,198 PASS / 279 FAIL / 20 ERROR**, exit1; skip/xfail/xpass0. All6,343 common nodes retain outcome/phase. The same299 unsuccessful node/phase keys, actual exception classes, typed refusals and frame-function sequences match154. Thread/child/subexpression coverage is not inferred. Full run additionally preserves57 passing subtest reports separately.
- I6 source probes38 /61 /13 /208 /34 /33 and202 controls PASS separately, including actual second INSERT, revocation, SAVEPOINT release/deferred COMMIT rollback, lease holding, originals, raw digest and pre-work budgets. Policy/schema/fingerprint/boundary/callsite/lint/format/report checks pass. Actual Python3.12.14 loads SQLite3.53.1; no alternate engine/setup/matrix.
- Product inventory160 files,6,025,551 bytes:137 Python /19 SQL /2 JSON /2 GraphQL. Hardened sdist **164 members,702,494 compressed /6,041,897 regular /6,174,720 tar-stream bytes**, all original finite limits retained. All164 direct/independently rebuilt derived wheel members, bytes, metadata, ZIP attributes and RECORD match; wheel SHA256 `2452e419e06eea774805fc89358130538c50fdd313fdb0fb9b82b230e99a39d8`; sdist SHA256 `9d228f889f9507cdc5a166b9658e80873fcbd48255c6c958eb90e33954014b54`. Packaging133 PASS.
- Each fresh installed artifact passes626 safety /212 wire /204 attributed review /4 resolved-wire /33 saved /34 Author /56 new regressions, plus I2/I3 and doctor. Source-backed installed scope is894 unique;5,603 ordinary source nodes remain unrun there. Original minimal Access smoke separately **FAIL1 in each artifact, PERMISSION_DENIED**,26 assertions reached/28 unreached.
- Real closed ZIP2,097,151 and2,097,152 allowed;2,097,153 and2,323,560 rejected with0 stdout and artifact-fallback stderr. Expanded6,120,583/compressed18,794 allowed. CRC/index/binding/BEGIN-DATA-END hashes and unchanged inputs verified.

**Provisional inherited scanner limitation:** parent handoff says taskA found a new case where queue allocation could occur after remaining budget exhaustion. Applicability to frozen154/this candidate is **unestablished and not reproduced here**. No taskA change/test was pulled. Passing existing probes and no measured integration regression do not rule out that possible inherited limitation. Independent review and the next integration checkpoint must reproduce the exact reviewed counterexample against154/candidate/later reviewed I6-C.

Initial exact-source hosted runs all terminal: [Development40002761103](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/40002761103) SUCCESS,0 product pytest/232 required-unexecuted files; [Access40002761153](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/40002761153) FAILURE, main2786=2487/279/20 inside broad3148=2849/279/20; [Pages40002761106](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/40002761106) SUCCESS,8 docs tests, deployment skipped. The Access product-lane union3148 omits3349 source nodes and all154 new nodes; docs/infrastructure lanes are separate. All24/123 receipt payloads verified against actual checkout `c915fc731bd60339e681a6af8f86a470058a5e06` / source tree. Fresh source-hosted299 identities/phases/first-line messages/refusals match; full messages280/299 and rendered frame projections135/299; actual hosted frames/assertion sidecars absent.

Known artifact downloads returned Azure Forbidden/0bytes; supported job-log receipts were verified. Upload completed, but full uploaded artifacts were not independently downloaded/byte-hashed. Actual hosted overflow was **not exercised**; normal Access receipt1,992,791 bytes is below2MiB. Missing direct Access filters remain a documented coverage limitation; no contract violation justified duplicate Development full testing or a workflow correction.

Two subsequent evidence/prose commits preserve all493 execution/distribution inputs. They add only the new evidence directory and a22-line verified BOM-log parsing lesson with12 strict controls. The first unpublished evidence commit's raw Git graph whitespace failed preflight but a shell chain continued; a normal corrective commit losslessly preserves those bytes, fixes transport/index, reruns prose/whitespace checks and retains the earlier commit. No history rewriting. Current660-payload index SHA256 `e2356b7d82f561dd9e3dc5745e30cb1b5df5568e9ce9f190d2d2f09aa8566449` verifies. CI's broader Git input hash is measured separately and may change with raw evidence files; it is not conflated with the493 execution inputs or sdist inventory.

Final publication CI has completed and its exact-head results follow. No Release workflow dispatch, existing PR branch modification, rebase/force-push, main merge, deployment or real data. This candidate remains fixed154+144+147; later independently reviewed I6-C integration and non-Author integration review are required.

The docs8 and infrastructure35 source-node identities are disjoint from Access3148. Across these separate workflows the mapped ordinary-source union is3191, leaving3306 of6497 unexecuted there. These ancillary tests are not product acceptance and are never added to Access product counts.

Actual final checkout `90e222635a01e89f095e9a256ac69ecfc759ec4e` has ordered parents frozen154 / final`fee364c6d61a5feebf08dbdd830a5a57ee2d872b`; its tree equals feature tree`ace7e44cd89194d189a30a0aa6cf513a45b3b87c`. All493 execution/build/distribution inputs independently match the tested tree. CI's broader Git-input hash changes from`106d274117017ca99caafb07b20c36eed6a9995dfa752f6bebfcfbe047618a67` to`ee1b871e0cd2fde4f24272975ada0c0da4a2ac32d6b8ba2511de6b356831d1e1` because649 new evidence paths enter that broader contract;0 changed-existing/removed CI inputs. The163-file distribution input inventory remains`38592a0e30468a80e442ee35d514673beace31eb98daf5cfda1109ac1675d4ed`.

Final Access independently rebuilds the same702494-byte sdist/hash and both equal wheels above. Its original minimal installed Access smokes still emit`AdmissionRefused: PERMISSION_DENIED`. Fresh local source versus each final hosted main/broad has exactly299 non-success identities with matching phase/outcome/first-line message/refusal sets. Full messages match280/299 and rendered project frames135/299; actual hosted ExceptionInfo/assertion sidecars are absent. No hosted assertion-reach or byte-identical traceback claim is made.

Strict final log receipts:

- Development86002bytes /21 indexed payloads, SHA256`9449cf850e69b9922fc8604f308d63f370e9b8df599e60ded74f823ae90a895c`.
- Access1993958bytes /123 indexed payloads, SHA256`60b73fee0f3fed6d0c220d94a5fb62b450ad18bbb2ff58c662bb3f9bee3b090a`.

Both closed ZIPs, BEGIN/DATA/END digests, complete index member bytes/hashes and run/checkout/tree bindings were independently verified. **Actual hosted overflow was not exercised**; the final Access receipt remains below2097152bytes. Normal artifact upload succeeded: Access artifact12524818073,856700515bytes, API/log digest`sha256:ca97a1db8fff294fad2d5d4be893e3f4338a9737381a17a9010ac1efc9a33872`. Final binary downloads were **not attempted** because initial reads established Azure Forbidden/zero-byte access limits; final targets were not newly denied, and full archive byte/hash verification is unexecuted. Log/API reads succeeded.

The exact-final-head audit is intentionally external to avoid another evidence/tree/CI cycle; its evidence index and report are preserved in the task workspace and handed to the parent. No CI is pending. Remaining gates are independent Author-unaffiliated review, resolving/reviewing the inherited299 failures and I6-C boundary, reproducing the provisional scanner finding, later reviewed-I6-C reintegration/revalidation, successful hosted overflow/download coverage where required, and separate Release acceptance. Development success confers no Release acceptance.
